associations.rationale: The formal type provides an unspecified Fin 2-indexed basis of the indicated subspace, but does not identify its basis vectors with X and Y.
The type states only that the indicated space has finrank 2; this is a consequence useful for a basis argument, not the basis assertion itself.
The type states linear independence of the displayed X,Y family, a component of establishing a basis rather than the full basis claim.
The type states that the span of the displayed X,Y family is top, another component of a basis proof rather than the basis declaration itself.
